subject: docs/coop/artifacts/doctor-contract.v1.json
reviewerStanding: INDEPENDENT. This reviewer did not author the subject and owes it nothing. This verdict binds the subject's START bytes, which were re-measured identical at window end.
verdictBasis: Two blockers survive independent measurement. Both are measurement-discipline failures under freeze 7.2.2 (recited values get HARD comparison), not design failures: the subject's substantive design positions -- the two verbatim carriages, the non-admission definition and its four honestly-standinged mechanism legs, the DR-105 boundary, the D9 structure-without-values split, and the redaction two-tier bound -- all survived adversarial measurement intact. Both blockers are narrow and single-clause correctable.

advisories.dispatchedEnumeration: corrupt install / unreadable lock / missing component / revoked signature / partial migration / disk full / permission denied on own state / clock skew / concurrent mutation by another process
advisories.covered: DEG-1 corrupt install; DEG-2 unreadable lock (including duplicate-key refusal that NAMES the key); DEG-3 missing component; DEG-4 revoked signature; DEG-5 partial migration. Five of nine, each with behavior, trap, and outcome class, and all five governed by DL-1 (always produces a report), DL-2 (never repairs) and DL-3 (never falls back to a different question).

noDefinedBehaviour.measuredAbsence: 0 occurrences of 'disk full', 'disk-full', 'ENOSPC' or 'no space' in the subject.
noDefinedBehaviour.whyItMatters: Two distinct paths are unaddressed: (a) doctor's OWN Operational-metadata audit write failing -- FC-RO's pass property REQUIRES that audit record to account for every in-root byte change, so a failed audit write leaves the read-only fixture's accounting undefined; and (b) a full disk as a DIAGNOSED condition, which has no check class. OC-5 covers only the report sink failing.

noDefinedBehaviour.case: permission denied on doctor's own state
noDefinedBehaviour.whyItMatters: Plausibly absorbed by DL-1 plus residual-limitation cause 'input-unreadable' via STATE-CLASS-HEALTH, but never stated. The generic absorption is a reasonable reading, which is why this is the weakest of the four.

noDefinedBehaviour.measuredAbsence: 0 occurrences of 'skew'; 0 of 'time source'; 'wall clock'/'wall-clock' appear 3 times, always asserting that generatedAt carries no identity consequence.
noDefinedBehaviour.whyItMatters: MATERIAL. environment.offlinePosture is defined as carrying 'the recorded AGE of the last-known revocation and metadata expiry state', and DEG-4's entire honesty rests on reporting that age plus a staleness residual limitation. An age is a clock difference. Under skew doctor reports a confidently wrong staleness, and file 04's own rule at line 222 ('Expired or future metadata cannot be partially understood') is clock-dependent. Nothing binds the time source, and no check class or residual-limitation cause covers an untrustworthy clock.

noDefinedBehaviour.measuredAbsence: 1 occurrence of 'concurrent' (not a case); 0 of 'refcount', 'atomic', 'torn read'; 'lease' appears 3 times, none binding doctor's reads.
noDefinedBehaviour.whyItMatters: MATERIAL. file 04 lines 71-72 record that 'active processes hold generation leases/refcounts and open references needed for safe completion/recovery', and lines 73-74 that GC cannot delete bytes referenced by locks or active processes -- so the corpus already models concurrency. Doctor reads lock, install inventory, index custody and state while an update, GC or another doctor may be mutating them. Nothing in the subject binds read consistency, so doctor may report a torn composite state that never existed at any instant -- a false report produced by a surface whose whole value is a truthful snapshot, and one that DL-3 (never answer a different question under the same check id) arguably already forbids in spirit without providing the mechanism.

advisories.severity: Advisory rather than blocker. degradedAndHostileInputs does not claim DEG-1..5 exhaust the space, and the seven-rule hostileInputDiscipline (bounded reads, no execution from data, no ambient resolution, parse refusal over best effort, terminal and sink safety, descriptor-controlled arguments, report integrity over content) is a genuinely strong second axis. But the subject also does not DISCLOSE the omission, and whatThisDoesNotDo -- fourteen bullets long and otherwise thorough -- names no unenumerated degraded case. Fix: either add DEG-6/DEG-7 for clock skew and concurrent mutation, or disclose them in whatThisDoesNotDo as cases with no defined behaviour.

advisories.claim: "Two subprocesses run for a bare `opensip <tool> doctor`."
advisories.measured: True only when the binary resolves. resolveBinary returns env-pin -> config-pin -> which/where (first hit wins), and probeBinaryVersion is called only 'if (resolution.found)'. With an operator pin set, `which` never runs (1 subprocess). With no pin and no binary on PATH, probeBinaryVersion never runs (1 subprocess). Two run only on the no-pin, found-on-PATH path.
advisories.severity: Advisory. The two timeouts recited alongside it replicate exactly: PATH_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000 and VERSION_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000. The DIFF's substance -- that the prototype executes with no consent on its default path -- is correct.

advisories.detail: ToolsDoctorResult's `totalCount` member has no V2 counterpart and no individual DIFF entry. DIFF-11 names the envelope replacement wholesale ('ToolsDoctorResult is three members (type, diagnostics, totalCount)') and stableMachineSchema.reportEnvelope.whatIsNotInTheEnvelope forbids an aggregate BOOLEAN, not an aggregate count. Likewise ToolsDoctorResult's `type` discriminant has no envelope counterpart, implicitly covered by DIFF-2's move into the host result model.
advisories.severity: Advisory, marginal. A derived count carries no honesty hazard, unlike the `ready` boolean DIFF-4 correctly rejects. Recorded for completeness because the dispatch named unnamed divergence as the highest-yield check and this is the only residue I found after enumerating all seven AdapterDoctorReport members and all three ToolsDoctorResult members.

unnamedDivergenceHunt.method: Enumerated every member of both measured prototype doctor surfaces and traced each to a DIFF entry, a carriedForward entry, an absenceStatement, or nothing. AdapterDoctorReport's seven members: tool, network, binary{found,command,path?,layer?}, version{detected?,minVersion?,status}, credentialEnv?{name,present}, installHint?, ready. ToolsDoctorResult's three: type, diagnostics, totalCount. Then read process-exec.ts, binary-resolver.ts, redact.ts, safe-diagnostic-data.ts, errors.ts, types.ts, exit-codes.ts and cli-diagnostic.ts for behaviours with a designed counterpart.
unnamedDivergenceHunt.result: NO substantive unnamed divergence found. network->DIFF-6; binary.path->DIFF-10; binary.layer PATH arm->DIFF-13; version.status undefined-collapse->DIFF-12; credentialEnv.name minting->DIFF-7; ready->DIFF-4; two-surface split->DIFF-5; escape from the closed union->DIFF-2; component-chosen exit->DIFF-3; secret preview/hash->DIFF-8; source-comment-only redaction bound->DIFF-9; absent versioning/environment/stability->DIFF-11; default execution with no consent->DIFF-1. Presence-only credential reporting, deny-by-default Error handling, ANSI-then-control ordering, string bounding with a truncation marker, the single descriptor-controlled IO boundary, layered resolution with a hard miss on a bad pin, and 'resolution NEVER fetches a binary' are all recorded at carriedForward rather than silently absorbed.
unnamedDivergenceHunt.absenceStatementsChecked: Seven absence statements verified as honest, including the measured one: AGENTS.md at the pinned commit contains ZERO case-insensitive occurrences of 'doctor' (I replicated this: grep -ic doctor AGENTS.md => 0), which is the pinned reference's own pointer for the doctor baseline. The subject records this as a measured absence in the reference's pointer rather than as a failure to look, and names the two surfaces it found by other means.
unnamedDivergenceHunt.assessmentVersusDR103Lineage: The DR-103 lineage's first generation was rejected for five unnamed field divergences (the manifest candidate's own review record carries that finding as B3: 'Five measured prototype command-manifest fields diverge silently with no DIFF entry'). This subject does not repeat that failure. A12 is the only residue and it is a derived count with no honesty consequence.

dr105BoundaryTest.question: Did the subject mint permission vocabulary of its own?
dr105BoundaryTest.mechanical: The DR-105 candidate (permission-truth-tables.v1.json, 0f73f31c..., parsed with a dup-key-rejecting hook) mints seven PT-* tokens in a closed vocabulary. The subject contains ZERO occurrences of 'PT-' and zero overlap with any token-shaped identifier in that candidate.
dr105BoundaryTest.semantic: CA-1..CA-4 are declared 'DOCTOR-SIDE, SURFACE-LOCAL action-class identities - the same status the control-protocol candidate's RF-* families hold on their plane. They are carriers, not permissions.' stableMachineSchema.identifierDiscipline repeats it for every identifier the schema introduces. The subject never says a CA class IS a permission.
dr105BoundaryTest.vocabularyProvenanceVerified: The authorization and execution records the subject calls 'File 03's existing vocabulary rather than invented here' are exactly file 03 lines 95-96: '- authorization: `requested`, then resolved to `granted` or `denied`; and' / '- execution: `enforced`, `disclosed-trusted-code`, or `refused`.' The hyphenated token 'disclosed-trusted-code' -- the one that most looks like a mint -- is file 03's own. The five laws the subject says hold regardless of DR-105's closure all replicate at file 03 lines 98-103.
dr105BoundaryTest.joinShape: consentRecord.permissionRef is a RESERVED BINDING POINT ({ reserved: true, ridesOn: ['DR-105'] }) that activates on the ROW's closure, not on any candidate's existence, reusing the manifest candidate's idiom and citing its RJ-6/RESERVED_FIELD_POPULATED rule at digest rather than re-minting it. The mapping is fixed only as TOTAL over the four classes and FAIL-CLOSED. The symmetry clause is present and correctly asymmetry-free.
dr105BoundaryTest.caveat: B2's stale clause sits inside the section making this claim; the claim itself is true and independently verified.

notableStrengths.verbatimCarriage: BOTH claimed-verbatim blocks are byte-exact. (1) Register row: file 08 line 277 matches registerRowQuoted.rowVerbatim exactly; the table header at line 261 matches tableHeaderVerbatim exactly; pipe-splitting the row yields the fifth cell 'Read-only/no-code/no-network default tests, stable schema, D9 mapping, redaction corpus' identical to acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim. (2) File 04 Doctor section: all NINE lines 226-234 match linesVerbatim element-for-element with the hard wrap preserved, and the section genuinely ends at 234 (235 blank, 236 '## Purge') -- no truncation. All six clauseInventory entries verify against the source folded on a single space; C-1 and C-2 are whole source lines, C-3..C-6 are correctly marked as reflowed with accurate line ranges.
notableStrengths.foldingMethodUsed: I folded the hard-wrapped markdown by joining consecutive lines with exactly one space, stripping nothing else -- no backtick, bold-marker, dash or whitespace normalization. Under that fold every clause matched. Where I later note markdown-marker stripping (A3, A4) it is in inline fragment citations, never in the two verbatim blocks.
notableStrengths.digestReplication: All 22 recorded digests replicate at my measurement: 6 governing sources, 2 candidate dependencies, 14 prototype files. Prototype HEAD == a62509d623173155d0946e9f5d5ca90c839893e0 with a clean tree, matching the pin recorded in prototype-evidence-reference.md.
notableStrengths.registerRowLineNumbers: All 14 recited file-08 row line numbers replicate (DR-007/40, DR-105/268, DR-103/266, DR-102/265, DR-111/274, DR-112/275, DR-119/282, DR-124/287, DR-125/288, DR-115/278, DR-123/286, DR-G12/327, DR-G03/318, DR-G21/336), and every quoted cell fragment from those rows replicates, including DR-115's 'RSS steady/peak 40/50 MB help-version, 60/100 MB doctor read-only' and DR-G12's four columns.
notableStrengths.readOnlyGuaranteeIsCarriedNotMentioned: The dispatch's central test. 'Admitting analysis' IS defined precisely -- extensionally, as six acts ADM-1..ADM-6, with an explicit notAdmission clause drawing the line at the transition into the host's semantic path rather than at the act of reading. A MECHANISM is named: four legs (VALUE/PROTOCOL/STATE-CLASS/TEST), each with its own standing statement, and a preventionMechanism.statedHonestly that says outright 'NONE of the four is measured enforcement in any shipping code', with a residualLimitation repeating it. That is CARRYING with a disclosed bound, not MENTIONING, and it is not a vacuous caveat -- it excludes the strongest available reading of its own claim.
notableStrengths.violationPathsClosed: Lock resolution touching the network: closed by DP-3 plus file 04's 'No missing payload triggers download, refresh, or lock mutation', quoted correctly from line 221 and applied at full width. Probe writing state: disclosed (the Operational-metadata audit record), grounded in file 04 line 205's state table, and FIXTURED at FC-RO. Corrupt install triggering repair: closed by DL-2 and DEG-1. Consented action escalating: closed by consentDoesNotCascade, which REFUSES rather than warns for a networked-posture target absent CA-4 -- and the residual unenforceability is reported as tension T-5 rather than papered over.
notableStrengths.d9StructureWithoutValues: Verified clean. No numeric exit or D9 value appears anywhere in outcomeStructure; whatIsNotBoundHere lists six value-side items including the observation->faultCause mapping; the DR-007 symmetry clause is present and correctly stated; and FC-D9 expressly refuses to pin a placeholder ('A fixture containing a numeric exit expectation would be this contract inventing what DR-007 owns'). The prototype's EXIT_CODES values (SUCCESS 0, RUNTIME_ERROR 1, CONFIGURATION_ERROR 2, CHECK_NOT_FOUND 3, REPORT_FAILED 4, PLUGIN_INCOMPATIBLE 5, CANCELLED 130 -- all replicate) appear only in the DIFF record, with an explicit non-adoption of CONFIGURATION_ERROR.
notableStrengths.redactionHonesty: The bound is stated and testable. Tier 1's guarantee is justified by the CONSTRUCTION path ('doctor never has the value in a report-bound member to begin with'), tier 2 is stated as DISCLOSURE with an enumerated list of what it does not catch, and seven explicit non-coverage items are stated in file 04's purge-section honest-exclusion form -- including THE FACT OF EXISTENCE and SIDE CHANNELS OF A CONSENTED ACTION, which are the two a weaker artifact would omit. FC-REDACT makes the high-entropy pass-through case a PASS condition rather than a buried limitation, which is the correct shape. A resolved configuration value not carrying a secret classification falls to tier 2 by tier 2's own definition ('any string doctor did not construct') and is therefore pattern-scrubbed under a stated disclosure -- I could not construct a report path that emits a secret while the contract claims otherwise.
notableStrengths.countsVerified: 4 consent classes (CA-1..4), 5 outcome classes (OC-1..5), 8 check classes, 5 degraded cases (DEG-1..5), 12 fixture classes, 11 identity dependencies, 13 prototype DIFFs -- every count in the dispatch replicates against the subject's own bytes. The only count that does NOT replicate is the prototype's 17-vs-16 (B1).

reviewSummary: REJECT at two blockers, both measurement-discipline failures with narrow single-clause corrections, neither touching a design position. The subject's substantive work is strong and survived adversarial measurement: both claimed-verbatim carriages are byte-exact, all 22 recorded digests and all 14 register-row line numbers replicate, the read-only guarantee's load-bearing line is defined extensionally with a named mechanism whose lack of enforcement is stated outright rather than implied, the DR-105 boundary is clean with zero minted permission vocabulary, D9 structure is bound with no value smuggled anywhere including the fixtures, the redaction guarantee states a bound I could not construct a path around, and the prototype DIFF set survived a member-by-member unnamed-divergence hunt that the DR-103 lineage failed twice. What fails is the arithmetic: a prototype set recited as 17 members that measures 16, and an existence claim about the working tree that the subject's own two other sections contradict. Correcting both is a two-line edit; the artifact should return for disposition rather than redesign.
